{{Top}}
'''Superintendent''' was the [[Police rank|title]] of the leader of the [[Galactic Alliance Security]] force. In [[44 ABY]] the post was held by [[Jestat Vhool]]. Vhool was in reality a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] who had infiltrated the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] government. Vhool was killed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]].

It was also a title [[Morlimur Snugg/Legends|used]] by the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
